descriptions.d24i_grid_fans_8010c62c: Two-pass scan of subdivided grid cells walking rows downward: each cell seeks the run-length cursor at +28 and reads its flags from the grid; flag value 16 draws the cell's triangle fan (0x8010b318) from its corner heights, flag value 17 draws corner triangles whose neighbour cell type (0x8010b560) matches, and a corner height of 0xffff is treated as absent; the first pass draws the near half and the second the far half.
